originalTitle: Watch: Trump floats rebranding artificial intelligence as super intelligence
summary: "The use of the word artificial makes it sound fake," he said told the UN. "It's not fake, it's actually amazing."
content:
Donald Trump has a penchant for branding and in his speech he gave artificial intelligence a new name: super intelligence.

"The use of the word artificial makes it sound fake," he said. "It's not fake, it's actually amazing. But we have to be careful," he added. "Welcome to the new world of super intelligence - SI," he went on to say.

Trump has previously argued that whoever wins AI, wins, and he is firmly against regulation. But that puts him at odds with many here.

The question is whether the slow pace of diplomacy can keep up with AI’s rapid development.
chineseTitle: 观看：特朗普将 AI 重新命名为超级智能
chineseSummary: “使用人工这个词听起来很假，”他告诉联合国。 “这不是假的，真的很神奇。”
chineseContent:
唐纳德·特朗普热衷于打造品牌，在演讲中他给人工智能起了一个新名字：超级智能。

“使用人工这个词听起来很假，”他说。 “这不是假的，它实际上很神奇。但我们必须小心，”他补充道。 “欢迎来到超级智能的新世界——SI，”他接着说道。

特朗普此前曾表示，谁赢得人工智能，谁就获胜，他坚决反对监管。但这使他与这里的许多人产生分歧。

问题是外交的缓慢步伐能否跟上人工智能的快速发展。
